name: Shandong Nanshan Fashion Sci-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Nanshan Fashion Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, design, production, and sale of worsted woolen fabrics, formal professional wear, and textile fibers in China. The company offers chemical textiles/fiber products. It also offers business suits, coats, school uniforms, and work clothes under DELLMA brand name. In addition, the company provides online and offline marketing services. Shandong Nanshan Fashion Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
